title: GY-FAIR/1 contract and goya-fair schema crate (Phase 0 — Disparates)

scope.objective: Author the FAIR contract and implement the schema, validation, canonical serialisation and coverage-summary crate. Extraction-only authority; no reconstruction, no extractor, no goya-ir coupling.
exclusions: No reference corpus nominated (deferred by decision, selection criteria recorded in roadmap).
No representability status above `extracted` is producible under this revision; `verified` is unreachable.

covers: non-extracted and undetermined statuses require register-form reason codes
unknown kind requires recorded observed spelling (ignorance preserved, not dropped)
canonical serialisation is order-independent and byte-stable
dynamic require() preserved as undetermined with DYNAMIC_REQUIRE_UNRESOLVED
coverage summary derived from element states

workspace_build.result: SUCCESS after repairing the pre-existing c37f900 fallout in goya-caprichios: non-exhaustive Artifact::AcceleratorModel id match (registry.rs), test initializers missing new HostProfile/Request fields, accelerator lowering precedence (GPU-driver gate precedes UTF-8, per the inventory-ignores-gpu-driver doc), and snapdragon tests lowering int8-only models on non-int8 silicon (SD810 et al.) — those tests now use the first int8-capable generation and expect UnsupportedAccelerator for int8_accel=false SoCs. goya-caprichios: 255 passed, 0 failed.

residual_failures.result: 4 failed (appimage gate Null vs EMP-PACKAGE; dpkg-deb zstd checksum error; 2x artifact sha256 vs build-report mismatch)
residual_failures.attribution: Pre-existing at HEAD and unrelated to this work: emperor's dependency closure (emperor-runtime, goya-lang, sash, serde_json, sha2) is untouched by this evidence. Not repaired here; belongs to the emperor/parity programme.

determinism.claim: canonical_json sorts elements by ID and uses BTreeMap key ordering; byte-identical output asserted across input orders in tests. Extraction determinism (identical input bytes + extractor version -> identical document) is a property of future extractors, not evidenced here.

honesty_notes: Phase 0 deliverable only. The programme cannot yet extract, migrate or verify anything.
Coverage percentages remain prohibited; coverage_summary is a derived count, never persisted as authoritative.
